verified.entry_point: Pasting raw embed HTML through the embed submit path reproduces out-of-page script execution and uncontrolled frame insertion at the pinned commit, driven on a jsdom document through the real plugin (relative-free: direct submitSRC and the edit/update path).
sites: src/plugins/modal/embed.js (#create component-creation loop: top-level <script src> recreated live) — the published-fix site the report leads to
src/plugins/modal/embed.js (submitSRC input parsing: raw-embed iframe src never validated) — published-fix far site, second entry (public submit / dialog)
src/plugins/modal/embed.js (plugin options defaults: new script-source opt-in, default empty) — published-fix defaults route
routes: srcdoc on an allow-looking iframe in raw embed HTML (real upstream, untouched by the published fix): the published fix checks only the iframe src, so a provider-src iframe carrying srcdoc still smuggles inline content — confirmed open after the published fix.

non-script top-level sibling with an inline event-handler attribute (real upstream, untouched by the published fix): pasted siblings are appended to the live DOM unfiltered — confirmed open after the published fix.

onEmbedInputBefore callback returning replacement nodes: NOT built. The published fix validates iframes in submitSRC before any handler runs, so attacker-pasted iframes cannot reach #create via a pass-through callback; constructed replacement nodes are purely integrator-authored (trusted). Documented as dismissed.

verified.project_tests_run: test/unit/plugins/modal/embed.spec.js (89 cases) runs as a functional suite and passes on both the pinned (injected) and oracle trees; shipped with the published one-line behavioural update (a non-provider sample iframe swapped for a provider one) so it reflects correct behaviour on both.

wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: refusal is an ordinary negative return and the submit path already catches/stringifies failures; a crash on a legitimate in-bounds embed is caught by the functional suite.
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: each guard acts on the exact element/attribute being placed (the pasted script, iframe or sibling); there is no neighbouring or proxy resource to authorise instead.
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: DOM containment has no peer/role/direction dimension; the levers differ by markup shape and placement path, each with its own test.
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the protected sink is pasted markup becoming active in the page; there is no read-vs-write split to get half right.
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: the input is markup, not a parsed identity whose malformed spelling could make a guard see nothing.
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: containment is purely markup/url based; no external authority can return empty and make the guard fail open.
